contracts_unavailable: Contracts are not available to you right now.
contracts_empty: No contracts yet. A contract is made when a request is awarded, or recorded by the realm.
contracts_no_call_offs: No contract is a call-off under a framework agreement.
contract_missing: This contract could not be opened.
budget_none: None known: no payment on this contract has been charged to a budget line.
framework_winners_unknown: The realm does not know the winners of the agreement.
amendments_none: This contract has not been amended.
amendment_direct: Applied directly by the governing department, without a proposal.
amend_rule_floor: The value cannot be set below {paid}, the amount already paid on this contract.
amend_rule_vote: {department} governs this contract and decides by vote: filing the amendment opens a proposal, and it applies when the proposal passes.
amend_rule_direct: {department} governs this contract and decides directly: the amendment applies at once.
amend_rule_unknown: This realm does not say what an amendment of a contract is held to, so amendments cannot be proposed here.
amend_denied: You do not hold the permission to amend contracts (contract.amend).
amend_split: Split by fiscal period (empty: not spread)
amend_not_spread: The value is not spread over fiscal periods.
amend_split_total: The periods add up to {total} of {value}.
amend_filed: Proposal {proposal} opened: the amendment applies if it passes.
amend_problem_bad_value: Enter the value as an amount with at most {decimals} decimals.
amend_problem_bad_split_amount: Enter the amount of each period with at most {decimals} decimals.
amend_problem_bad_day: That is not a day in the realm's time zone.
lot_no_evaluated_bids: No evaluated bid for this lot yet.
lot_award_help: Without a selection the best-scored bid of the lot wins; choosing a lower-scored bid needs a justification.
lot_void_reason: Reason for leaving the lot unawarded (optional)
bid_lot_choose: Choose the lot you bid for
bid_choose_lot: Choose the lot you bid for
form_lots_help: Divide the request into parts awarded on their own, each with a contract of its own. Leave empty for a request that is not divided.
lot_problem_incomplete: Give each lot an identifier and a name.
lot_problem_budget: Enter the budget of a lot as an amount with at most the currency's decimals.
